evals.prompt: I need to collect Scope 3 data from our top 50 suppliers. Most are small Italian companies. Can you help me create a questionnaire?
evals.expected_output: Selects Module A (Environmental), uses simplified version for SMEs, generates EN+IT questionnaire.
assertions: Selects environmental module for Scope 3 data
Recommends simplified version for small suppliers (<50 employees)
Generates questionnaire in both English and Italian
Includes cover letter with collaborative tone

evals.prompt: We need to do CSDDD due diligence on our supply chain. What questions should we ask our suppliers about human rights?
evals.expected_output: Selects Module B (Social/CSDDD), generates human rights focused questionnaire.
assertions: Includes questions on child labor, forced labor, freedom of association
